rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 18 years old to take the Life in the UK Test

rules.description: Applicant must be under 65 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not need to take the test if you are 65 or over

rules.description: Applicant must have an accepted form of ID
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have a valid passport, EU ID card, travel document, BRP/BRC, or eVisa share code to book the test

rules.description: Name provided must exactly match the name on ID document
rules.reason_if_failed: The name you provide must be an exact match with the name on your ID document

rules.description: Applicant must not have already passed the test for this application type
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not need to take the test again if you have already passed it for this application

rules.description: Test must be booked at least 3 days in advance
rules.reason_if_failed: You must book your test at least 3 days (72 hours) in advance

explanation_template: Life in the UK Test eligibility: {outcome}

edge_cases.description: Applicant has a long-term physical or mental condition
edge_cases.action: Exempt from test. Requires exemption form or doctor's letter. Route to manual verification by Home Office.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has changed gender and requires sensitive booking
edge_cases.action: Email sensitivebookings@homeoffice.gov.uk before booking to ensure previous gender does not appear on test result. Manual process required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant requires special accommodations due to disability
edge_cases.action: Route to test centre selection with accessibility requirements. May require additional equipment or help accessing centre.

edge_cases.description: BRP or BRC used for ID is near or past expiry
edge_cases.action: Check that test date is no later than 18 months after BRP/BRC expiry date. If outside window, request alternative ID.
